adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a `cook_method` that can be set to `:raw_html` and in `Post#cook` it returns `raw` directly when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, explicitly skipping the normal cooking/sanitizing pipeline (`app/models/post.rb`). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and stores HTML from RSS (`PollFeed`) or from `Readability::Document` (`TopicEmbed.import_remote`), which only whitelists tag/attribute *names* (`tags: ...`, `attributes: %w[href src]`) but does not constrain attribute values/schemes. That means attacker-controlled HTML from any page on the configured embeddable host could include e.g. `<a href="javascript:...">` or dangerous `img/src`, and it will be served as live HTML on the Discourse origin (and also rendered with `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`). This is a verifiable XSS risk introduced by the new raw_html cook bypass.
